name: Market Analysis + Paper Trade (5min)
prompt: Analyze the configured markets and connected venues, infer the most relevant instrument and timeframe from context and recent structure, and return one executable paper-trade setup if a valid edge exists. Do not assume a fixed symbol or timeframe. Compare venues and instruments before choosing. If a setup is found, provide the selected venue, symbol, timeframe, entry, stop, take profit, position sizing, and the evidence behind the setup. If no valid setup exists, say WAIT and explain why.

name: Daily Risk Assessment
prompt: Perform a daily risk assessment. Review portfolio exposure, correlation risks, stop-loss coverage, venue reliability, and overall portfolio health. Report any concerns and whether policy changes are needed.
